Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing, external-service and installer-opacity review of MiTeC Weather Agent and Mail Checker; no installer extracted or executed and no service/account accessed

WeatherAgent.OuterInstallerVersion: WA_Setup.exe has blank FileVersion/ProductVersion fields; PE metadata identifies Michal Mutl and copyright 2013-2021.
WeatherAgent.PublishedBehavior: Current conditions and forecasts up to 16 days, moon phases, sunrise/sunset and user-selected locations; based on MiTeC Weather Forecast component.
WeatherAgent.CurrentTargetList: Windows 2000, XP, 2003, Vista, 7, Server 2008, 8, 8.1 and 10; no Windows 11 claim.
WeatherAgent.CurrentPageLicense: Free for private and commercial users. This conflicts with the general support EULA statement that unregistered freeware is non-commercial; resolve product-specific terms and redistribution before commercial use or bundling.
WeatherAgent.Unknowns: Weather-service endpoint, API-key requirement, location precision, outbound fields, persistence, startup, installer actions, dependencies and removal behavior are not established by the page or outer PE inventory.

MailChecker.OuterInstallerVersion: MAILCHECKER_Instal.exe has blank product/version metadata; outer PE copyright identifies Michal Mutl, 2001-2013.
MailChecker.PublishedBehavior: Checks multiple mailboxes, recognizes spam, can delete messages and display plain-text/HTML mail, supports SSL retrieval from Gmail, includes its own SMTP module for replies/new messages, can run from removable media and records a detailed task/status journal.
MailChecker.CurrentTargetList: Windows 2000, XP, 2003, Vista and 7; no current Windows 11 claim.
MailChecker.CurrentPageLicense: Free for private and commercial users. This conflicts with the general support EULA statement that unregistered freeware is non-commercial; resolve product-specific terms and redistribution before commercial use or bundling.
MailChecker.Unknowns: Exact protocols, OAuth/app-password requirements, send/delete confirmation, message/credential persistence, SMTP recipient controls, outbound data and installer actions are not established.

TermsPage.Observation: General MiTeC support EULA states trial/unregistered freeware is non-commercial. This differs from both product pages' commercial-use claims.

ReviewFindings: Both outer artifact hashes were recomputed and match the frozen inventory. Weather Agent's prior listing exposes only PE resources; Mail Checker did not parse as a 7-Zip archive. Neither result reveals an installer payload or action list.
Weather Agent may send a selected location or related fields to an unspecified weather provider. No location, API key or account was entered and no network request was made.

Mail Checker can expose personal messages and credentials, delete remote mail, send new mail/replies and maintain a journal. Testing requires a disposable isolated mail server/accounts, synthetic messages/recipients, a send sink and verified deletion/recovery controls. No real mailbox or credential may be used.

Both product pages claim private and commercial freeware, but the general support EULA says unregistered freeware is non-commercial. Treat commercial use and redistribution as unresolved until written product-specific clarification.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Published features, frozen versions, outer installer pins, platform lists and conflicts between product-page and general EULA terms are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Installer payload/actions, provider/protocol behavior, credentials and data flow, persistence/removal, local entitlement, current-target support, UI and activation remain unverified.
Deferred: Do not extract or execute either installer during source review; acquire no location, API key, mailbox password, OAuth token or personal message.

Any Weather Agent test needs a disposable location and reviewed endpoint/data flow. Any Mail Checker test needs an isolated sink with synthetic accounts/messages/recipients and verified no-send/no-delete defaults plus recovery.
Resolve product-specific use and redistribution terms before commercial use or packaging; do not infer Windows 11 support from legacy publisher target lists.
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: External-service, mail-control, license and opaque-installer gates are clearer, but no whole legacy outcome was accepted, retired or excluded. Estimates remain unchanged.
